They claim it's an environmental tax, but we know better – it's just another extraction scheme by the hidden elites and institutions to bleed dry actual businesses. They're coordinating in the background to keep plastic bottles clogging rivers and drains everywhere, with zero genuine investment or concern. It's all manipulation to protect their concealed interests.
